items.name: Barby Cube 2026
items.information:
L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€.
Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BarbyCube2026#70766-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. 
Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule).  

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BarbyCube2026#70766-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczVkIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0464d9393ec8beda5bced7e4e963ea197166594d/image.png)

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) and [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org/) as the Heartland Regional Championship of 2026.

Competitors from Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion.
